title: The Armbreaker's Tonfa Canon
summary: A canon of lever and snap methods that use the rail and the handle post to break an arm at the elbow.

title: A Treatise on the Unbroken Wheel
summary: Teaches the turning guard that never stops spinning and the flurry that bursts out of it when the wheel opens.

title: The Field-Reaching Tonfa Treatise
summary: For a student whose qi lives as a field around the body and can lengthen every stroke past the baton.

title: On Carrying Qi Past the Short End
summary: Shows how qi is pushed beyond the tip of the short end to pierce and whip at a distance of a hand.

title: The Dual-Track Rail Canon
summary: Trains a Champion to run the left and right rails as two tracks of one fight with paired timing.

title: Manual of the Hawk-Winged Rails
summary: Teaches the spread guard and stooping drop of the hawk wing style to a Xiantian cultivator of the baton.

title: Treatise on the River-Turned Long Arm
summary: Describes how the long arm follows the bends of a river current through an opponent's guard and into the basin of the body.

title: The Wind-Sworn Rail Reader
summary: A reader for wind-sworn students who learn to hold the rail like an oath and let the crosswind carry each strike.

title: Plateau Bearing Baton Canon
summary: Teaches a Champion to take and hold a bearing along the plateau edge and fight without giving ground.

title: The Gale Oath Tonfa Treatise
summary: A Xiantian treatise on the oath of the turning gale that drives the baton through flurries and long thrusts.
